name: Together Provisioned Throughput
desc: Reserved capacity for open models, billed per token with an uptime SLA.
desc_zh: 为前沿开源模型预留推理容量，按 token 计费并附带可用性承诺。
solves: Serverless is cheap but best-effort and dedicated endpoints need tuning; this form factor keeps token pricing while guaranteeing the capacity underneath it.
solves_zh: Serverless 便宜但不保可用，专属端点又要自己调；这一档保留按 token 计费，同时把底层容量锁定下来。
best_for: You are moving an open-weight model from a pilot into production and need a capacity number you can put in a contract.
best_for_zh: 要把开源权重模型从试点推上生产，需要一个能写进合同的容量数字时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.together.ai/blog and https://www.together.ai/products）。 Announced 2026-07-08, inside the window; not in the ledger (the ledger holds only Together AI@2022-06-01). The post says it launched for MiniMax M3 and GLM-5.2 with a one-month minimum term. Second source is the same publisher; no independent media write-up was located. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Provisioned Throughput」，加上厂商名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.together.ai/blog/provisioned-throughput
